data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $26.5m during 2017 (2016: strengthening of $2.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding (closing 2016 balance) were $324.8m. During 2017 the syndicate reported a release of prior year reserves of $26.5m, driven by favourable claims development across the portfolio, resulting in a net prior-year reserve release and contributing to the syndicate's 2017 performance.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $26.5m during 2017 (2016: strengthening of $2.6m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount sourced from Managing Agent narrative sentence. The report contains a gross claims development table (triangle) but the 'Movement in the provision' line in the Technical Provisions note aggregates current-year movements; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' table was provided. The narrative figure was used as the best available gross prior-year movement. The claims development triangle is present but in percentage form and the absolute-by-age cumulative rows are printed as current estimates by underwriting year; triangulation was not performed to re-derive the gross PYD. Amounts remain in the report's functional currency (USD).
